extraction.Name: Dick Gayton
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Sold for $7000.00 Received $6000 in cash and applied $1000 of fathers debts owed to Miller Brothers
extraction.NOTES: Delivered in Agency; allottee says he never saw the land before or after sale and cannot say as to value of land; it would appear that a fair price was received; wife and four children dependent upon allottee for support; no funds to credit of allottee; notarized November 21, 1928, County of Kay, State of Oklahoma; witnesses both of Ponca City, Okla.
